text: Karen Mills, Accessibility Consultant and Nick Rossi, Accessibility Consultant, Accessibility Unit, Equity and Human Rights, People and Equity Division will provide an update on the Disability Inclusion Action Plan and a review of the Guiding Principles. The Accessibility Unit is in the process of reviewing and updating the City’s five year Accessibility Plan to identify, remove and prevent barriers that impact City residents, visitors, and employees with disabilities and will provide an overview of work underway.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
